notes.title: It’s time to join Steam Next Fest！！（Detailed Patch Note）
notes.notes:
The Steam Next Fest in June started. Fight of Steel open demo is downloadable on Steam.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40575192/2f64387bbc5a0bbda12dcb93bffe8096dd9c4778.jpg
We previously shared trailers for playable characters ET and Oil King. In this demo, you can redeem them freely in the Shop. ET and Oil King will stream Fight of Steel sometime this week and maybe they will be playing online matches with players. If you want to join the games, please keep an eye on our page. You might want to practice a little bit before the matches, or you want to play the game by yourself. Here are some tips for playing the game for the first time:

1. We would suggest you get familiar with the system by trying Training mode or Arcade mode. And then you can play Story mode to dip your toes in the world settings of Fight of Steel. In Story mode, there will be STEELs from the three factions showing up. We recommend you try Challenge mode later than the previous modes.

2. Online matches. You can play and practice Casual Match with your friend. If you want to challenge yourself, you could find some challenging players in Ranked Matches. Be warned, players in Ranked Matches are usually fierce.


Lastly, if you have clips of you playing the game, the interesting Skins you put together, and any thoughts you would like to share on social media, you can tag them with #FightOfSteel. That way it would be easier for us to get it!.


We welcome you to try the game!

Detailed Patch Note：
[olist]
 Fix bug for some gamepad button malfunction in Shop or Customization pages.
 Increase HP recovery amout for players each round.
 Adjust AI judgement for defending projectile.
 Adjust state change between Air Recovery and on ground.
[/olist]
